name: K2-D2
author: IanMealworm
description: K2-D2 is an astromech-style autopilot suite for KSP2: maneuver node execution, ascent guidance, automated landing, docking, and attitude hold, all from one panel (Alt-O or AppBar). Port of Christophe Floutier's original K2-D2 (built for SpaceWarp1) to the Redux modding framework.
